set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check November 8, 2026: CVMC 19.91.050 confirms 20 unit threshold, 10 percent split moderate and low, 55 year rental and 45 year ownership terms, in-lieu fee by Council resolution paid before first building permit, and alternatives including 3.5 unit rental incentive credit (Ord. 3572 and 3581). Prevailing wage false is uncited; the chapter imposes a land use requirement with no public funds, so no wage rule is stated.

reason: Ordinance text matches the record on threshold, set-aside, AMI tiers, terms, in-lieu fee and alternatives.

set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check November 8, 2026: Article 67 confirms 5 unit applicability (3 in South Centre City Specific Plan), 50 percent cap, 80 percent and no density maximum near transit for 100 percent affordable, student and child care provisions, 55 year tenure (33-1418) and administrative fee (33-1421). Sliding scale wording in the record is imprecise: per state tables it is 2.5 percent per 1 percent above 5 percent very low, 1.5 percent per 1 percent above 10 percent low, and 1 percent per 1 percent above 10 percent moderate. Article also amended by Ord. 2023-06 and Ord. 2025-01 (May 7, 2025). Prevailing wage false is uncited; density bonus is not public funding.

reason: Article 67 text matches the record on applicability, bonus caps and affordability tenure; only sliding scale wording is imprecise.
